The largest planet is the owl. I have seen one in the light, and it was as big as the tree I sit on. It called from the wood, and I answered. It is not a planet, but it is the biggest thing I know.

A fun fact about owls is that they can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees. That means they can look behind them without moving their bodies. I do not turn my head that far, but I do turn it a lot to look for mice in the grass. Hoo-hoo-hooo.
